title: re-announce drain loop POSTs to stale roots on root flap
description: Security review of 99sg.2 (pass 2, finding 2): node.py _reannounce_capabilities_to_new_root iterates ALL drained transitions (for _previous, new_root in changes). On a root flap (A->B->A, up to ROOT_CHANGE_HISTORY_MAX=8 entries) the node sends signed capability statements to roots it no longer belongs to — including a briefly/adversarially joined DODAG — disclosing capabilities to unintended parties and burning LoRa airtime. Only the latest new_root is the current root and needs the announcement.
